name: ECC — Mass User/Role/Group Administration by One Operator
description:
Attacker objective
Manipulate access at scale in the ECC banking application — mass-modifying users, deleting roles, or removing groups — as a compromised or rogue operator, to escalate privilege or disrupt access.

Attack logic
ECC records every user/role/group administration action with the operator identity. A single operator performing an unusually high volume of these changes in a short window indicates mass privilege manipulation rather than routine day-to-day administration.

Why this detection works
Aggregating ECC administration actions per operator over a short window separates a mass-change burst from the steady, low per-operator rate of normal administration.

False positives
A legitimate bulk role/reorganisation or onboarding/offboarding batch performed by an authorized operator.

Tuning
Set the per-operator burst threshold above the routine administration rate; allowlist sanctioned bulk-change windows; review the operations and affected users.

Required telemetry
ECC application audit (apps-*, type=ECC_USR_AUDIT): USRADT_LOGIN_NAME (operator), USRADT_OPERATION/USRADT_ACTION, USR_LOGIN_NAME (target), USRADT_WS.
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. operator = the ECC admin identity; review the operations (user/role/group changes) and the affected users.
2. Confirm whether a sanctioned bulk change was scheduled; if not, treat as a compromised/rogue operator and disable the account pending review.
3. Correlate the operator's workstation (USRADT_WS) and login with endpoint/AD activity.
false_positives: A legitimate bulk role/reorganisation or onboarding/offboarding batch performed by an authorized operator.
query:
FROM apps-*, -apps-*-2025 METADATA _id, _index, _version
| WHERE type == "ECC_USR_AUDIT" AND USRADT_LOGIN_NAME IS NOT NULL
| EVAL operator = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(USRADT_LOGIN_NAME, "@"))
| STATS changes = COUNT(), operations = VALUES(USRADT_OPERATION), targets = VALUES(USR_LOGIN_NAME) BY operator
| WHERE changes >= 30
